$comment: Copy to ~/.pi/agent/geocine.json and edit. Project override: .pi/geocine.json (consultants merge by name).

modes.$comment: Session profiles: which consultants are selectable, who rescues by default, and the prescreen policy ('skip' = never, 'force' = every staged consult, 'consultant' = per-consultant flag). Switch via /geocine mode (session or persisted); pin one per project with 'mode' in .pi/geocine.json (e.g. 'sensitive' in an RE folder).

frontier.$comment: OAuth providers (pi /login, stored in ~/.pi/agent/auth.json) need no envKeys: consultant children are pi processes on the host and inherit auth. envKeys are only for API-key providers inside the docker jail.
frontier.role: hard debugging, root-cause analysis, and planning complex changes

local-big.role: second opinion that costs nothing; quick sanity checks and code review

abliterated.role: content strict models falsely refuse: reverse engineering, security analysis, decompiled binaries
abliterated.notes: Fallback consultant for content that strict cloud models falsely refuse (reverse engineering, security analysis, decompiled binaries).

approval.$comment: Gate for LLM-invoked consult tool calls (user-typed /consult never asks). 'ask' prompts yes/no/always-allow/auto-all; 'auto' never prompts. Per-consultant: "autoApprove": true.

watchdog.$comment_baseUrl: Optional tier-1 LLM watchdog. Use a SECOND small model instance (e.g. Qwen 4B on another port), never the main single-slot server — a side request there evicts the main KV cache.

context.$comment: context-keeper. mode: 'arc' = deterministic compaction digest (no model call, instant, recall recovers exact content), 'checkpoint' = LLM-written structured checkpoint, 'off' = pi default. compactAtTokens = compact EARLY while a local provider is active — pi's own threshold (contextWindow - reserveTokens) is minutes of prompt re-ingest too late on a local server. idleCompactMinutes = also compact after N idle minutes past half the threshold (cost lands while nobody waits). pruner = ingestion-time head/tail trim of oversized bash/powershell outputs (cache-neutral: trimmed ONCE at capture, full output stashed for recall). recall = transcript search (exact regex primary, BM25 fallback) + full entry read-back. notes = model-written facts pinned VERBATIM into every digest; reminderTokens = pre-compaction reminder lead so the model pins state before the cut (0 = off).

qwen.$comment: Persisted Qwen thinking state set via /harness (auto mode + budget level) — survives restarts and /reload. imageLevel overrides the level for turns whose latest message carries an image (set via /harness image <level|inherit>; omit for no override).

harness.$comment: Transparent tool aliasing: advertise each model family's RL-trained tool names/schemas on the wire (qwen-code, grok-build, codex dialects) while pi stays canonical. Set false to disable renaming; the trained-tool equivalents (todo, web_fetch, web_search, apply_patch) stay registered either way.

pdf.$comment: read_pdf tool (pdf-reader extension, @firecrawl/pdf-inspector). maxChars caps one call's output — the tool fills whole pages, then names the omitted pages so the model fetches exactly what it needs next. maxSearchMatches caps `search` result lines.

web.$comment: Provider behind web_fetch/web_search. 'auto' = first available (tinyfish when its key is present, else builtin DuckDuckGo scrape; a keyed provider that errors mid-call falls back to builtin for that call). Pin 'tinyfish' or 'builtin' to force one — pinned providers surface their errors. tinyfishApiKey: literal key or '$VAR_NAME' env reference; TINYFISH_API_KEY env var also works.

rescue.$comment: Captures manual local->frontier /model switches as rescue episodes in the consult-log. /distill drafts a lesson from the last episode using distillConsultant (default: prescreen.consultant).
